definition: to tidy and wash the rooms of a home
description: A living room the morning after a party. A young man in sunglasses, a white T-shirt, grey joggers and yellow rubber gloves mops the wooden floor, which is covered in confetti, streamers and party hats, while holding a full black bin bag in his other hand. He stops, lifts his sunglasses and looks around at the mess. Two young people are asleep on the sofa behind him, lampshades hang from the ceiling, and a woman stands by the doorway as sunlight comes through the window.

en.question: What is the man in gloves doing?

de.question: Was macht der Mann mit den Handschuhen?
